name: Ranger
source: Pathfinder GM Core, "Building Creatures", Class Road Maps, via Archives of Nethys: https://2e.aonprd.com/Rules.aspx?ID=2874
license: ORC License: Paizo's Pathfinder GM Core is ORC licensed material.
rules: High Perception; moderate Nature and moderate to high Survival; high Str or Dex; high AC; moderate attack and high damage (or for a simpler ranger, remove Hunt Prey, and just use high attack and high damage). Abilities: Hunt Prey, hunter's edge, nature's edge, masterful hunter, swift prey, companion or combat style and related feats

notes.skills: Moderate Nature and moderate to high Survival.
notes.offense: Moderate attack bonus and high damage (or, for a simpler ranger without Hunt Prey, high attack bonus and high damage).
notes.specials: Hunt Prey, hunter's edge, nature's edge, masterful hunter, swift prey, companion or combat style and related feats.
